name: Michael Alig
heard: Michael / Michael Allig / Michael Allen / Michael Alec
context: Christopher first saw him on Geraldo; Michael gave him and Pebbles jobs, got James to take them in and taught Christopher to promote parties in the Limelight and later Club USA offices. Christopher says that as the fame, money and drugs grew he slid into the role of caretaker, got out, but visited Michael in prison and stood by him; he thinks the prison system gave Michael no way back

name: Pebbles

name: Club Kids

name: New York
